chapter.verse: A gensa bangin Topa in Sarah' tungah thupha pia a, a gensa bangin Sarah’ tungah Topa in hih hi.
Sarah gai hi, ama' tunga Pasian in a gensa hunin a teek zawhin Abraham tawh tapa khat nei hi.
Abraham in Sarah tawh a neih ama' tapa’ min Isaak phuak hi.
Pasian in ama' tunga a thu piaksa bangin amah in ni giat a phak ciangin Abraham in a tapa Isaak a vun at hi.
A tapa Isaak a suah ciangin Abraham kum za pha hi.
Sarah in, “Pasian in kei’ adingin nuam-a nuihzak nading hong bawlsak khin hi; a za peuhmah in nuamin hong nuihpih ding uh hi,” ci hi.
Amah in, “Sarah in nau nawi pia ding ci-in kua in Abraham’ tungah gen ngei ding ahi hiam? Ahi zongin a teek khitin amah tawh tapa khat ka nei hi,” ci hi.
Naupang khang a, nawi tawh hong kikhen ta hi; Isaak nawi tawh a kikhen ni ciangin Abraham in pawi lianpi khat bawl hi.
Ahih hangin, Abraham tawh a neih Izipt-nu Hagar’ tapa in ama' tapa Isaak a simmawh bawlna Sarah in mu hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in Abraham’ kiangah, “Hih sila-numei a tapa tawh lawnkhia in; bang hang hiam cih leh sila-numei’ tapa in ka tapa Isaak tawh gamhluah lo ding uh hi,” ci hi.
Ama' tapa’ hangin Abraham’ tungah thu nuam het lo hi.

Ahih hangin Pasian in Abraham tungah, “Tangvalpa leh na sila-numei hangin lungkim loin om kei in; Sarah in nang' tunga hong gen peuhmah ama' hong gen bangin gamta in, bang hang hiam cih leh Isaak tawh na suan-le-khakte’ min kilo ding hi.
Amah pen nangma' ta ahih manin, sila-numei’ tapa zong minam khat in ka bawl ding hi,” ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin zingsangin Abraham tho baihin an leh tuithawl la-in Hagar pia a, ama' liangko tungah naupang tawh suanin amah sawl khia hi. Amah pai khia a, Be-ersheba gam sungah vak kawikawi hi.
Thawl sunga tui a bei ciangin amah in sawlbawk nuai khatah naupang lawn hi.

Tua ciangin amah pai-in a hoih khop khat a gamla, thal lot khat tan bangah a ta nungngatin tusuk hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in, “Naupang’ sih hong musak kei in,” ci hi. Amah nungngatin a tut lai takin naupang in a aw sangsakin kap hi.

Pasian in tangvalpa’ aw za hi; Pasian’ vantungmi in vantung panin Hagar sam a, ama kiangah, “Hagar aw, bang in hong lungkhamsak hiam? Lau kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh tangvalpa a omna mun-a a kahna awging Pasian in za hi.
Ding in, tangvalpa la in la, na khut tawh kip takin len in; bang hang hiam cih leh minam lian khatin amah ka bawl ding hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin Pasian in ama' mit haksak a, amah in tuikhuk khat mu hi; amah pai-in tui tawh tuithawl dimin tangvalpa dawnsak hi.
Pasian in tangvalpa ompih a, amah khangto hi; amah gamlakah teng a, thal lot siampa khat hong suak hi.
Amah Paran gamsungah teng hi; a nu in Izipt gam panin ama ading zi khat la hi.
Tua hun lai takin Abimelek leh a galkap mangpa Fikol in Abraham’ kiangah, “Na’ sepna khempeuhah Pasian in nang hong ompih hi;

tua ahih ciangin tu-in kei hita leh ka tate hita leh ka suan-le-khakte hita leh tungah a man lopi-in hong bawl loin, nang' tungah thuman tak tawh kong gamtat bangin keima' tung leh tawl khat na omna leitang tungah nong gamtat nadingin Pasian tawh kei tungah hong kiciam in,” ci hi.
Abraham in, “Ka kiciam ding hi,” ci hi.
Abimelek’ nasemte in a suhsa tuikhuk tawh kisai thu Abraham in a lungkim lohna Abimelek' kiangah a gen ciangin,
Abimelek in, “Kua in hih hiam ka thei kei hi; nang nong gen kei a, keimah in tu ni dong ka za nai kei hi,” ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Abraham in tuu leh bawngtalte la-in Abimelek pia a, tua mi nihte in thuciamna khat bawl uh hi.
Abraham in a tuuhon sung panin tuu-nu-no sagih tuam koih hi.
Abimelek in Abraham' kiangah, “Hih na koih tuam tuu-nu-no sagihte bang a cih nopna ahi hiam?” ci hi.
Amah in, “Keimah in hih tuikhuk ka tawhna thu-ah nang in keima adingin teci na hih theih nadingin nangmah in ka khut sung panin hih tuu-nu-no sagihte na la ding hi,” ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tua mun Be-ersheba kici hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute gel in tua munah thu kiciam uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in Be-ersheba-ah thuciamna khat bawl uh hi. Tua khit ciangin Abimelek leh a galkap mangpa Fikol, Filistia mite’ leitang-ah ciahkik uh hi.
Abraham in Be-ersheba-ah makeng kung khat suan a, tua lai munah Tawntung Pasian, Topa ’ tungah thungen hi.
Filistia mite’ leitangah Abraham, sau veipi sung peemta-in om hi.
